title: Long Multiplication for Kids | Step-by-Step Math Lesson
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn how to multiply double-digit numbers step by step. This lesson guides students through long multiplication with regrouping, from 2-digit by 1-digit to 2-digit by 2-digit problems.

title: Multiplying: understanding by using area models | Khan Academy
subject: Mathematics
summary: Sal Khan demonstrates multiplication using area models. This visual approach helps Grade 5 students understand why multiplication works before moving to standard algorithms.

title: Math Antics - Fractions Are Parts
subject: Mathematics
summary: Math Antics explains fractions as parts of a whole. Visual models and clear explanations help Grade 5 students build a strong conceptual foundation before working with fraction operations.

title: How Your Vital Body Organs Work? | Systems of The Human Body | Dr Binocs
subject: Science
summary: Dr. Binocs explains how vital body organs work including the brain, heart, lungs, digestive system, and more. A comprehensive overview of human body systems for Grade 5 science.

title: Here Comes the Sun: Crash Course Kids #5.1
subject: Science
topic: The Sun and Its Influence on Earth
summary: Crash Course Kids explores the Sun's role in our solar system. Learn about sunlight, energy, and how the Sun drives weather, climate, and life on Earth.

title: Solving Problems Around the Fort! | SciShow Kids
subject: Science
summary: Jessi and Squeaks think back to all the times they solved problems around the Fort. Teaches engineering thinking and problem-solving skills aligned with NGSS for Grade 5.

title: How To Draw Princess Rosalina from Super Mario Galaxy
subject: Art
summary: Learn to draw Princess Rosalina from Super Mario Galaxy. This advanced drawing lesson teaches proportion, facial features, and character design for Grade 5 artists.

title: Meet the Ocean's Wildest Animals! | Super Animals Full Episode | Nat Geo Kids
subject: Science
summary: Dive into the ocean to meet amazing animals that live in or near water. Learn about marine adaptations, food chains, and ocean ecosystems in this Nat Geo Kids full episode.

title: Math Antics - Adding and Subtracting Mixed Numbers
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn to add and subtract mixed numbers with like and unlike denominators. Convert between improper fractions and mixed numbers as needed.

title: Math Antics - Multiplying Fractions
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn to multiply fractions by fractions. Multiply numerators and denominators, then simplify. Understand why multiplying fractions makes numbers smaller.

title: Math Antics - Dividing Fractions
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn the keep-change-flip method for dividing fractions. Keep the first fraction, change division to multiplication, flip the second fraction, then multiply.

title: Math Antics - What Are Percentages?
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn that percentages are fractions out of 100. Convert between fractions, decimals, and percentages. Find percentages of numbers using mental math strategies.

title: The Volume Song | Finding Volume of Rectangular Prisms
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn to find the volume of rectangular prisms by counting unit cubes or multiplying length x width x height. Understand that volume measures space inside a 3D shape.

title: The Coordinate Plane Song | X and Y Axes
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn about the coordinate plane with x-axis and y-axis. Plot points using ordered pairs (x, y). Understand how coordinates locate points on a grid.

title: The Order of Operations Song | PEMDAS
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn the order of operations using PEMDAS - Parentheses, Exponents, Multiplication, Division, Addition, Subtraction. Solve multi-step expressions correctly.

title: The Exponents Song | Powers of Numbers
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn about exponents as repeated multiplication. 2 to the power of 3 means 2 x 2 x 2 = 8. Understand base, exponent, and power in exponential notation.

title: The Ratios Song | Comparing Quantities
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn about ratios as comparisons of two quantities. Write ratios in three ways - with words, with a colon, and as a fraction. Simplify ratios when possible.

title: The Classifying Triangles Song | By Sides and Angles
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn to classify triangles by sides (equilateral, isosceles, scalene) and by angles (acute, right, obtuse). Understand the properties of each triangle type.

title: The Classifying Quadrilaterals Song | Hierarchy of Shapes
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn the hierarchy of quadrilaterals. All squares are rectangles, all rectangles are parallelograms, all parallelograms are quadrilaterals. Understand inclusive definitions.

title: The Transitional Words Song | Connecting Ideas
subject: English
summary: Learn transitional words and phrases that connect ideas in writing. First, next, then, finally, however, therefore, in addition, for example, and more.

title: The Persuasive Writing Song | Convince Your Reader
subject: English
summary: Learn to write persuasive essays that convince readers. Use claims, reasons, evidence, and counterarguments. Understand ethos, pathos, and logos appeals.

title: The Informative Writing Song | Teach Your Reader
subject: English
summary: Learn to write informative essays that teach readers about a topic. Use facts, definitions, details, and examples to explain and inform clearly.

title: The Narrative Writing Song | Tell a Story
subject: English
summary: Learn to write engaging narratives with a clear beginning, middle, and end. Develop characters, setting, and plot. Use dialogue, description, and pacing effectively.

title: The Theme Song | Central Message of a Story
subject: English
summary: Learn to identify the theme or central message of a story. Theme is the lesson about life that the author wants readers to learn. Distinguish theme from main idea.

title: The Character Traits Song | Internal and External
subject: English
summary: Learn about internal traits (personality, feelings, thoughts) and external traits (appearance, actions, speech). Use evidence from the text to support trait identification.

title: The Mood and Tone Song | How the Story Feels
subject: English
summary: Learn the difference between mood (how the reader feels) and tone (how the author feels). Identify word choices and details that create mood and tone.

title: The Genres Song | Fiction, Nonfiction, Poetry, Drama
subject: English
summary: Learn about different literary genres - fiction, nonfiction, poetry, and drama. Understand the characteristics of each genre and how to identify them.

title: The Food Chain Song | Producers, Consumers, Decomposers
subject: Science
summary: Learn about food chains and food webs. Producers make food, consumers eat other organisms, and decomposers break down dead matter. Understand energy flow in ecosystems.

title: The States of Matter Song | Solid, Liquid, Gas
subject: Science
summary: Learn about the three states of matter - solid, liquid, and gas. Understand how particles behave differently in each state and what causes matter to change states.

title: The Ecosystems Song | Biomes and Habitats
subject: Science
summary: Learn about different ecosystems and biomes - forests, deserts, grasslands, tundra, oceans, and freshwater. Understand how living and nonliving things interact in each biome.
